The ergonomic design, combined with its lightweight construction at just 55 grams , ensures that the mouse is comfortable to use for extended periods without causing fatigue.

Born to push the very limits of ultra-lightweight gaming, The Razer Viper Mini takes up a smaller form that remains just as big in performance.

 RAZER VIPER MINI

 Born to push the very limits of ultra-lightweight gaming, the Razer Viper Mini takes up a smaller form that remains just as big in performance.  61G ULTRA-LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN

Flagship PAW3950/PAW3395 Sensor

 The AJAZZ AJ159 Series features the high-end PAW3950 (AJ159 APEX) and PAW3395 sensors (AJ159, 159P, 159 PRO) by PixArt, which have been finely tuned for peak performance. It boasts a maximum sensitivity of 30,000 DPI for the 159 APEX and 26,000 DPI for the AJ159, 159P, and 159 PRO models. The AJ159 APEX can be overclocked to 42,000 DPI, alongside a tracking speed of 750 IPS and 50G acceleration. These features set the AJ159 APEX apart in the marketplace, offering unmatched precision and speed.

 
 
 
 Advanced Tri-Mode/Dual-Mode Connectivity and High Polling Rate

 The AJAZZ AJ159 Series supports seamless switching between Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless, and wired connections. Uniquely, it offers an 8000Hz polling rate in wireless mode and 1000Hz in wired mode (AJ159/159P: 1K Wired and Wireless), delivering an ultra-low response time of 0.125ms—eight times faster than standard gaming mice, ensuring instantaneous feedback and smoother cursor movement.

 
 
 
 Efficient 400mAh Battery with Low-Power Consumption

 Equipped with a 400mAh battery, the AJ159 Series incorporates AJAZZ's advanced low-power consumption technology, significantly extending battery life to support prolonged gaming sessions without frequent recharges.

 
 
 
 Magnetic Charging Base with Customizable Display

 The AJ159 PRO and AJ159 APEX come with an innovative magnetic charging dock. Featuring an RGB colorful display screen, the charging dock of AJ159 APEX not only shows the date and time but can also be personalized with animated GIFs, adding a unique and vibrant touch to your gaming setup.

 
 
 
 Ultra-Lightweight Design for Superior Handling

 Weighing in at only 56 grams, the AJ159 Series is designed for agility and comfort. Its lightweight construction ensures flexibility and ease of movement, enhancing your gaming performance without the drag of a heavier mouse.

 
 
 
 100 Million/80 Million Clicks Micro Switch

 The AJAZZ AJ159 APEX and 159 PRO are equipped with Huano Green Shell White Dot Transparent switches (AJ159/159P: Huano Blue Shell Pink Dot Transparent Switch—80 million clicks). Designed for durability and precision, the Huano Green Shell White Dot Transparent Switch is engineered to withstand up to 100 million clicks, making it an excellent choice for gamers and those who demand reliability and longevity from their peripherals.

 

 
 
 Note :The 2.4GHz receiver for the AJ159 PRO/APEX is built into the magnetic charging dock, allowing the mouse to be used once the dock is connected to the computer.

SteelSeries Rival 5 – The Wired RGB Gaming Mouse Built for Every Genre and Every Gamer

 Not every gamer plays the same way. Some demand lightning-fast FPS precision. Others need programmable buttons for MMO abilities and MOBA combos. Some want both. The SteelSeries Rival 5 Wired RGB Optical Gaming Mouse is the rare gaming mouse that delivers everything — a world-class optical sensor, nine fully programmable buttons, ultra-precise navigation controls, stunning Prism RGB lighting, and a lightweight comfortable design that performs at the highest level across every game genre you play.

 Available now at White Angel Computers Jordan — your number one destination for gaming peripherals and PC accessories in the Kingdom.

 
 TrueMove Core Optical Sensor – 18,000 DPI Precision

 The foundation of the Rival 5’s exceptional performance is the SteelSeries TrueMove Core optical sensor , delivering tracking accuracy up to 18,000 DPI with true 1-to-1 movement tracking. The TrueMove Core captures every movement you make with perfect fidelity — no hardware acceleration, no prediction algorithms, no smoothing that distorts your inputs.

 Whether you are tracking targets at low DPI with wide, deliberate movements or executing rapid flicks at high sensitivity, the TrueMove Core responds instantly and accurately every single time. The sensor performs consistently across a wide range of surfaces, from cloth and hard mousepads to textured desk surfaces, ensuring that your tracking quality never suffers regardless of your setup.

 The adjustable DPI settings allow you to cycle through multiple sensitivity profiles on the fly using the dedicated DPI buttons, giving you the flexibility to switch between different games or playstyles without diving into software menus.

 
 Nine Programmable Buttons for Total Control

 What truly sets the Rival 5 apart from standard gaming mice is its nine fully programmable buttons — far more than the typical five or six found on most competitors. These additional buttons transform the Rival 5 into a powerhouse of in-game functionality, particularly for MMO, MOBA, and strategy game players who need rapid access to multiple abilities, items, and commands.

 The side buttons are thoughtfully positioned for easy thumb access without requiring you to shift your grip or take your hand off the mouse. Every button can be assigned any action, macro, or command through SteelSeries GG software , allowing you to build a fully optimized control scheme tailored to each game you play. Multiple profiles can be stored directly on the mouse’s onboard memory, so your configurations are always available no matter which PC you use.

 
 Precision Aim Button for Critical Moments

 The Rival 5 features a dedicated Precision Aim button that instantly drops your DPI to a lower, more controlled sensitivity when held down — then snaps back to your normal DPI the moment you release it. GravaStar Mercury M2 Wireless Gaming Mouse for Competitive Gaming

 The GravaStar Mercury M2 Wireless Gaming Mouse RGB Transparent Black is built for gamers who want fast performance, accurate tracking, lightweight control, and a unique futuristic design. With its transparent black body, RGB lighting, wireless connectivity, and high-performance gaming sensor, this mouse delivers a strong balance between style and speed.

 Designed for gaming setups, streaming desks, and modern PC builds, the GravaStar Mercury M2 gives users a clean wireless experience with a bold look. Its transparent black design makes it stand out from regular gaming mice, while the RGB lighting adds a powerful visual touch to any setup.

 Transparent Black Gaming Design

 Futuristic Look with RGB Lighting

 The GravaStar Mercury M2 comes in a stylish Transparent Black design that gives the mouse a premium and futuristic appearance. The transparent shell allows the design details and lighting to stand out, making it a great match for RGB gaming setups, black PC builds, and modern desk spaces.

 The built-in RGB lighting adds more personality to the mouse and helps complete the gaming look. Whether your setup is dark, colorful, minimal, or full RGB, the Mercury M2 fits perfectly as a stylish gaming accessory.

 Lightweight Shape for Better Control

 The Mercury M2 is designed with a lightweight body that helps improve movement speed and control. A lighter mouse can make fast flicks, tracking, and quick reactions feel easier, especially in FPS, battle royale, MOBA, and competitive games.

 Its shape is made to feel comfortable during long gaming sessions, giving users smooth handling without adding unnecessary weight.

 High-Precision Gaming Sensor

 Accurate Tracking for Gaming

 The GravaStar Mercury M2 is equipped with a high-performance PAW3395 gaming sensor , designed to deliver accurate and responsive tracking. This helps gamers move with better precision, whether they are aiming in FPS games, controlling camera movement, or performing quick in-game actions.

 With up to 26,000 DPI , the mouse gives users a wide sensitivity range, making it suitable for different play styles and preferences. Players can use lower DPI for precise aiming or higher DPI for faster movement depending on the game.

 Smooth 1000Hz Wireless Polling Rate

 The Mercury M2 supports a 1000Hz wireless polling rate , giving fast communication between the mouse and the PC. This helps reduce input delay and makes movement feel smooth and responsive during gameplay.

 For competitive players, fast response is important because every movement and click can affect performance. The Mercury M2 is built to keep up with fast gameplay and quick reactions.

 Wireless Gaming Performance

 Tri-Mode Connectivity

 The GravaStar Mercury M2 supports multiple connection options, including wired, Bluetooth, and 2.4GHz wireless . This gives users flexibility to choose the best connection method for gaming, work, or daily use.

 For gaming, the 2.4GHz wireless connection is ideal for low-latency performance. Bluetooth is useful for laptops and everyday tasks, while wired mode allows users to play while charging.

 Rechargeable Battery

 The mouse comes with a rechargeable battery, making it practical for daily use without constantly replacing batteries. With long battery performance, users can enjoy extended gaming sessions, work hours, and regular use with fewer interruptions.

 The USB-C wired option also makes charging easy and convenient.

 Programmable Buttons and Custom Control

 5 Programmable Buttons

 The GravaStar Mercury M2 includes 5 programmable buttons , allowing users to customize controls based on their gaming or productivity needs. Players can assign commands, shortcuts, or macros to improve control and make actions easier during gameplay.

 This is useful for games that require quick commands, ability activation, weapon switching, or custom shortcuts.

 Better Setup for Different Games
